Report: ‘The Hanging Tree’ played amid tear gas at France concert

Hindustan Times reports that the Hunger Games song played amid tear gas at a concert in France, linking it to wider protest symbolism.

By LokkeeVerse · 1 min read

‘The Hanging Tree’ from The Hunger Games played amid tear gas at a concert in France, according to a Hindustan Times headline.

The outlet’s accompanying description identifies the song and the franchise’s three-finger salute as symbols of resistance, citing their appearance in protests in Thailand, Myanmar and France.

The supplied metadata does not identify the concert, its location within France or its date. It also does not explain the circumstances surrounding the tear gas.
